mapper.sql: (#{${scopePath}.dataScope} = 'enterprise' OR ${ownerColumn} = #{${scopePath}.userId} OR (#{${scopePath}.dataScope} = 'team' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM enterprise_team_member actor_team JOIN enterprise_team team ON team.enterprise_id = actor_team.enterprise_id AND team.id = actor_team.team_id JOIN enterprise_team_member owner_team ON owner_team.enterprise_id = team.enterprise_id AND owner_team.team_id = team.id JOIN enterprise_member owner_member ON owner_member.enterprise_id = owner_team.enterprise_id AND owner_member.user_id = owner_team.user_id JOIN app_user owner_user ON owner_user.id = owner_member.user_id WHERE actor_team.enterprise_id = ${enterpriseColumn} AND actor_team.user_id = #{${scopePath}.userId} AND owner_team.user_id = ${ownerColumn} AND team.status = 'active' AND team.deleted_at IS NULL AND owner_member.status = 'active' AND owner_user.status = 'active' )))

${alias}.enterprise_id = #{${scopePath}.enterpriseId} AND ${alias}.kind = #{${scopePath}.kind} AND ${alias}.deleted_at IS NULL AND (#{${scopePath}.maintainAll} OR (
AND (${alias}.owner_user_id = #{${scopePath}.userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM resource_grant g WHERE g.enterprise_id = ${alias}.enterprise_id AND g.resource_id = ${alias}.id AND (g.capability = #{${scopePath}.capability} OR (#{${scopePath}.capability} = 'view' AND g.capability = 'edit')) AND ((g.subject_type = 'enterprise' AND g.subject_id = ${alias}.enterprise_id) OR (g.subject_type = 'user' AND g.subject_id = #{${scopePath}.userId}) OR (g.subject_type = 'team' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM enterprise_team t JOIN enterprise_team_member tm ON tm.enterprise_id = t.enterprise_id AND tm.team_id = t.id WHERE t.enterprise_id = g.enterprise_id AND t.id = g.subject_id AND t.status = 'active' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND tm.user_id = #{${scopePath}.userId} ))) )) ))
AND ${alias}.status = 'active' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enterprise_member om JOIN app_user ou ON ou.id = om.user_id WHERE om.enterprise_id = ${alias}.enterprise_id AND om.user_id = ${alias}.owner_user_id AND om.status = 'active' AND ou.status = 'active')
